title: A report's Deviations line names only a departure from a rule, ruling or brief; an unchecked claim goes elsewhere
why: Owner 14:01 CST Nov 13, on a coordinator report: "Deviations: #3243's round 1 reviewer ran haiku-5-5..." shown as a deviation although it was intentional: "so something's going wrong in the prose".
note: Todo. Candidate wording (retrospective): a Deviations line names only a departure from a rule, ruling or brief. A claim the session did not check goes elsewhere (for example "Unchecked:" under Next). An act that matches its rule row is not listed. Home: rule reports-order-of-labels. Triage applies this to its own reports from now on (undoable). Past rulings not checked; adding a label may need the owner's word. Retrospective 14:03 CST: owner item fb-1401-3 is the second time a Haiku round 1 was reported as a deviation (first: the retrospective's 11:14 note to runner 10, fb-1115-2). This step covers the report side. A Haiku round 1 that matches the reviewer row is not a departure (round 1 for a guard or check change runs Sonnet by item 359 a, so which applies depends on the change kind; unchecked per PR).
